sources.articleTitle: Elon Musk claims ‘I’m not Maga’ and says he regrets vast sums to back Republicans
Elon Musk says record spending on US midterms was 'pretty foolish'
Elon Musk says he's "not MAGA," feels "foolish" about midterm spending

headline: Elon Musk Expresses Regret Over Midterm Spending And Denies Maga
seoTitle: Elon Musk Regrets Midterm Campaign Spending
metaDescription: Billionaire Elon Musk stated he feels foolish regarding his recent campaign financial contributions and clarified he does not identify with the Maga movement.
aiSummaryBullets: Elon Musk stated he feels foolish for investing significant sums into 2026 midterm political campaigns.
The billionaire clarified that he does not identify with the Make America Great Again movement.
Musk participated in the New York Times Dealbook summit via video call from China.
aiContextParagraph: Billionaire Elon Musk has expressed regret regarding his financial involvement in the 2026 United States midterm elections. Having contributed hundreds of millions of dollars to support various Republican candidates, Musk characterized his decision to provide that level of funding as foolish. During a recent virtual appearance at the New York Times Dealbook summit from China, the businessman also sought to clarify his political positioning. Despite previous alignment with Donald Trump and frequent attendance at the White House, Musk explicitly denied being a member of the Maga movement. These comments signify a notable shift in public stance for the entrepreneur, who had previously been closely associated with the political movement since 2024. The remarks were delivered during a summit discussion, marking a departure from his recent history of intense participation in American electoral processes and political advocacy.
whyItIsViral: This story is trending due to coverage by three independent outlets and a rapid pace of reporting shortly after the billionaire's public comments.
